turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen learned about his zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Explain that.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
You found time to enter a zero. Find time to explain it.
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then answer like a teacher. On what basis?
